sonicScene.thesis: The Tidewriter, illustrated (Pass 4): an anime ocean designed from the ground up -- a tiny island with one windswept palm and a few rocks, graphic water in flat colour regions with crest strokes and sparse foam, the sun's reflection a path of broken marks from the horizon to your feet, illustrated cloud formations, a sport motor yacht cruising past, dolphins leaping across the path. Colour is the instrument: the music moves the whole world between violet sunset, golden afternoon and electric blue, while the bass writes its history into the swell.

composition.background: a violet-to-peach sky, broad tapered sun rays, illustrated cloud formations (flat undersides, a few lobes, lit coral toward the sun, mauve in shadow) in two drifting layers
composition.midground: a tiny island on the left third: a low dune, one windswept palm reaching toward the sun, a boulder group at its left end, a thin surf line; the yacht crossing in front
composition.foreground: graphic water: indigo troughs, a cobalt body and lavender wave backs cut from the swell's height and faces, pale turquoise crest strokes and pink-white foam as tapered dashes, the sun's path a column of broken warm marks that widens toward the viewer
composition.focal: the low sun on the right third and its reflection path down to the foreground
secondary: the motor yacht and its wake
composition.atmosphere: distance haze on land and clouds; the far sea converges on its middle tone
composition.post: a little bloom on the sun and the path
composition.camera: still: 10 m over the water, 36 mm, the horizon at 47 % from the top (46.5-47.5 % through the breath)

palette.background_value: mid (a coral horizon under a violet sky)
palette.saturation: three coordinated palettes on one axis (violet sunset, golden afternoon, electric blue) plus a bioluminescent night end

very_slow: the cloud banks turning round the viewer (two layers, parallax)
medium: three Gerstner trains (their pace and dominant direction on controls)
extremely_fast: the path's marks flaring on hats

vocabulary: PALETTE: a build moves the world toward golden afternoon and electric blue; a breakdown sinks it back to the violet sunset; the water's bands tighten
TIDEWRITING: the bass's last ~15 s roll in as swell; the water's body deepens and the crest light lifts
a lifted front rolls in; crest light, foam and the sun rays flash
the swell grows and quickens (an integrated phase: no crest jumps), the rays strengthen (slowly)
the rays reach further for a moment
the sun path's marks and the crest strokes flare; mint enters the lit faces
the sky's middle turns pink, the clouds' lit undersides warm, the halo swells
a slight warm or cool drift of the whole grade
sparks on the sun's path, by pitch and velocity
PALETTE: violet sunset -> golden afternoon -> electric blue
WAVE ENERGY: chop, foam and the tide's depth
SUN RAYS: strength, reach, halo and the sun's path on the water
CLOUDS: the glow on the clouds
WATER COLOUR: the richness of the water
SPRAY: drums' spray and notes' sparks
WAVE SPEED: the authored pace to 2.5x, without a crest jumping
WAVE DIRECTION: the cross swell gives way to the wind sea
BAND CONTRAST: soft painted bands to crisp cel shading
HIGHLIGHTS: the crest strokes brighten and widen
FOAM: more and brighter foam caps
SURFACE DETAIL: streaks across the bands
LEAP: a dolphin arcs across the sun's path
HERO WAVE: a big swell rises far out and rolls in, foaming
FLARE: the sun and its rays blaze and settle
DAYBREAK: the world sweeps to electric day and back to the sunset
the swell rolls, clouds and rays drift, the yacht crosses every ~75 s, pods leap every 53 and 79 s
sonicScene.tier: light: a graphic sea (three meshes, eight deformers each, a 48-op program near and 38 far), seven unlit programs, a tiny island with one palm and eight Kenney rocks, a yacht and its masked wake, 16 cloud formations (one lofted pillow each), fixed particle pools; no lights, no shadows, no fog march
sonicScene.title: Digital Ocean
